thread:
maria: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we need to lock ownership and timelines for streaming partial/timeout fixes. Can we confirm owners?
cheng: I can take the reconnect/backoff changes (client/server handshake). Target EOD Tue?
devon: I'll own the prefix/KV cache regression watchers + add telemetry hooks. aiming Thu COB.
eli: I'll handle automated replay tests for partial responses and add a small test matrix. done by next Wed.
sre-oncall: we need an interim mitigation to reduce user-facing timeouts — lowering nginx proxy timeout to 90s and enable early reconnect hints. I'll do the change in ~30m. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: nginx-timeout-reduce -> canary in us-west at 2026-03-24T14:00Z
cheng: for reconnect, propose backoff windows [100ms, 200ms, 400ms] and max attempts 6. Also add metric streaming.reconnect.attempts with tags (model, region).
devon: noted, will add metric and dashboard. Will also add alert if reconnects > 0.5% of opens in 10m window.
maria: action list — assign owners and due dates:
```
- Reconnect/backoff impl: cheng — due 2026-03-24
- Telemetry (reconnect + partials): devon — due 2026-03-25
- Replay test matrix: eli — due 2026-03-26
- Short timeout canary: sre-oncall — done 2026-03-23
- Rollout checklist + rollback plan: maria — due 2026-03-25
```
maria: please add any blockers or update if dates are unrealistic. We'll sync Fri 10:00 for status.
cheng: no blockers, will PR today and tag @devon for telemetry hooks.
devon: might need a small schema bump for the reconnect metric; i'll coordinate with infra.
eli: adding test cases now, will post results and replay logs in this thread.
sre-oncall: can confirm canary completed and reduced user errors in us-west by ~40% vs baseline. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maria: thanks — I'll convert these to Tracker tickets and ping owners. Closing loop here, pls update thread when you hit milestones. :handshake:
